name: lxi-tools
description: Open source tools for managing network attached LXI compatible instruments

readme.summary: Excellent clarity and examples for usage, but completely missing installation instructions and troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No installation instructions provided - users cannot get started without knowing how to install the tools

injection_risks.description: The enter_interactive_mode function may be vulnerable to injection attacks if user input is not properly sanitized.
The scpi function may be vulnerable to injection attacks if the scpi_command parameter contains unsanitized user input.

critical_findings: Potential injection vulnerabilities in interactive mode and SCPI commands.
Lack of input validation for user-provided data.
security.summary: The lxi-tools package has some security concerns, including potential injection vulnerabilities and lack of input validation, but no critical secrets or error exposure issues were found.

common_complaints: VXI/11 protocol connectivity breaking in newer versions
Missing features in CLI tool (--raw argument, instrument name parameter)
GUI usability issues (missing context menu support on macOS, mDNS port/protocol detection)
Device compatibility gaps and lack of generic screenshot plugins
praise_themes: Appreciation for project work and effort
Interest in new features like live view
Desire to integrate with lxi-tools for device manufacturers
sentiment.summary: Community shows moderate engagement with feature requests and bug reports, but complete lack of maintainer responses across all issues since March 2025 indicates potential project abandonment or severe maintenance neglect.

red_flags: Occasional lack of detail in explanations
Some questions are not directly addressed
communication.summary: The maintainer is generally helpful and patient, but could provide more technical depth and clarity on some points.
